thread:
lena: Quick note: onboarding run for Monarch-11B (gptq-int4) shows a drop in summarization F1 vs fp16 on our news set. Low-hanging observation: some sentinel tokens appear shifted after conversion.

tom: can you share exact exporter command + flags? are you using the new append-sentinels option?
lena: used exporter v0.9.2 with --append-sentinel true and the gptq-int4 recipe (blockwise per-channel). Command log excerpt: 
```
exporter --model-dir=/mnt/checkpoints/monarch --recipe gptq-int4 --append-sentinel
WARNING: id collision with tokenizer; applying tail offset +1 for 3 tokens
```
peggy: that warning is scary. If the tokenizer->embedding mapping diverges, prompt prefixes won't align. Any evidence in runtime logs?
lena: yes during streaming smoke test we saw repeated KV warnings and a streaming drift: 
```
KV cache expected columns 128, got 127 -- truncating
Mismatch token id for <sep>: tokenizer=30010, embedding=30011
```
oz: two axes to check: 1) token id translation table (exporter should emit), 2) rotary/head ordering. If exporter inserted tokens into vocab tail, kv indices shift and rotary frequencies might be applied to wrong positions.
peggy: do you see headwise rotary_scale != 1? Monarch uses heterogenous head scales in layer 0.
lena: dump from model header: 
```
heads: 16
rotary_scales: [1.0,0.92,0.92,1.0,0.8,0.8,1.0,0.95,...]
first_token_ids: [1, 50, 30010, 502, 30012]
```
ci-bot: CI artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-onboard/monarch/1712604322/token-dump.txt :white_check_mark:
tom: narrow repro: remap tokenizer sentinel ids -> embedding ids (apply +1 for the three flagged tokens) and re-run gptq-int4 quantized eval on 1k news samples. If scores recover, exporter mapping is the culprit.
lena: remapped locally and ran a 200-sample smoke: rouge-L improved from 0.31 -> 0.395 (fp16 baseline 0.4). So mapping was a big factor.
oz: good. But we should also sanity-check the quant recipe differences: per-channel blockwise vs per-tensor symmetric can interact with small embedding shifts. Run quick ablation: gptq per-channel, gptq per-tensor, awq 4-bit.
peggy: also add a unit test in exporter CI: assert tokenizer.ids for special tokens match embedding indices post-export or fail the build. Exporter should produce mapping.json with pairs like {"tokenizer_id":X, "embedding_id":Y}.
ci-bot: ISSUE created: export-mapping-ci-1712604322 (link: https://issues/redwood/12345)
lena: plan for this thread: 1) push remap hotfix to the onboard snapshot so downstream tests pass (lena) 2) add exporter mapping.json + CI assertion (peggy) 3) run quant ablation (tom) 4) if regression persists, dump rotary freq ordering & kv index trace (oz).
peggy: FYI I think some older exporters appended a single sentinel and shifted the rest; newer ones sometimes append multiple. We'll normalise behavior and add explicit logs.
lena: uploading patched snapshot and will post updated eval numbers. Thanks folks. :rocket:
